# Tuesday bus connections

Mum's appointment is at eleven. The hospital bus arrives at ten twenty or eleven fifteen, so a ten-minute consultation occupies most of a morning. She calls this an independence problem; I keep trying to solve it with a calendar. The café beside the stop is quiet and accessible. A shared list of places to wait might be more useful than a more precise appointment reminder. [[Care arrangements]] is missing the journey around the visit.
